deadline.value: International applicants: January 15 for Fall (September) entry; applications reviewed on a rolling basis (Winter March 30, Summer September 1).
deadline.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. | International applicants Term Annual application deadlines Fall (September) January 15 Winter (January) March 30 Summer (May) September 1

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: You must choose a Chemistry faculty member as supervisor before admission; supervisor support is part of the application.
supervisor.quote: applicants are required to select one of our faculty members to be their supervisor and preside over an applicant’s program before they are accepted for admission

funding.value: All admitted graduate students are funded while making satisfactory progress; PhD minimum CAD 25,000 a year for 4 years (from an MSc) or 5 years (from a BSc), as stipend plus employment.
funding.quote: we provide financial support for all graduate students admitted to our program. This financial support is guaranteed provided that the student continues to make satisfactory progress in their program. | PhD students: $25 000/year for 4 years (from previous MSc) or 5 years from BSc.

entry_route.value: A thesis-based MSc is normally required; applicants without one are admitted to the MSc and may transfer to the PhD after one year.
entry_route.quote: To be considered for admission to the Chemistry (PhD) program, you must normally hold a thesis-based Master of Science degree. | Students without a thesis-based MSc will be admitted as MSc candidates, with the option to transfer into the PhD program after one year of satisfactory studies.

notes: Three-year PhD (after an MSc); Fall, Winter and Summer entry.
